Employment is projected to rise to 22,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 1,600 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $94,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).

AI will not replace postsecondary political science teachers, but it will take over material preparation. Automated organization, compilation, and courseware speed up routine lesson preparation, shifting teachers' time from finding materials toward classroom debate, research design, and value judgments.
